audience: A lay reader who has just read the invented scenario and has no AI background.
shows: How one question can find one record across many agents without any private file moving. Three steps, one focal agent.
complements: The text tells the story of one clinic; the figure shows the crowd of agents and the one small public mark, so the reader sees how little has to move.
surrounding_text: The broker posts an ordinary-looking page. Agents everywhere read it in the course of their work. Each agent quietly checks the private records it can already see. Almost all of them find nothing. One finds a match. It sends no files and posts the clinic's holiday hours as asked, with one comma in an unusual place. The broker's software reads the public internet and sees the comma.
alt: Three numbered steps from an invented scenario. A question goes public. Eighteen agents each check their own files; seventeen find nothing and one, shown inverted, finds a match. That agent posts holiday hours with a circled comma, a broker reads it, and no private file leaves. It shows that a search can work without moving a file.
caption: A scenario, not a report: one question, many agents, one small mark in public.
